text: {"label": "Refining Skill Acquisition Teaching Procedures","definition": "Research on making skill acquisition programs more effective and efficient, examining antecedent and consequence variables such as differential reinforcement, feedback timing, instructive feedback, mastery criteria and learning arrangements.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centres on procedural variables in teaching new skills to learners, not behavioral skills training for staff, broader instructional systems like Direct Instruction or precision teaching, or college academic performance."}
